title: Red Hat Security Advisory: OpenShift Container Platform 4.16.75 bug fix and security update
description: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.16.75 includes multiple security fixes addressing vulnerabilities in OpenSSH, PCRE2, and OpenSSL components. These include security bypasses, use-after-free, out-of-bounds writes leading to arbitrary code execution, memory corruption, and acceptance of forged messages. Users of OpenShift Container Platform 4.16 are advised to upgrade to this release to mitigate these issues.
